The '''Copa Ecuador''', officially known as '''Copa FEF Ecuador''',<ref name=Report>{{cite web|url=http://www.ecuafutbol.org/web/noticia.php?idn=42510&idc=1#.XCOebHRKiM9|title=INFORME TOTAL SOBRE LA ESTRUCTURA DE LA COPA ECUADOR|publisher=Ecuafútbol|date=7 August 2018|access-date=26 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181226232855/http://www.ecuafutbol.org/web/noticia.php?idn=42510&idc=1#.XCOebHRKiM9|archive-date=26 December 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> is a knockout football competition in men's domestic Ecuadorian [[association football|football]] organized by the [[Ecuadorian Football Federation]] that started in 1970 and was reinstated in 2018.

The winners qualify for the first stage of the following year's [[Copa Libertadores]] and the [[Supercopa Ecuador]] against the Serie A champions.<ref name=Report/><ref>{{cite web |title=La Supercopa se jugará en enero del 2020 entre los campeones de la LigaPro y la Copa Ecuador |url=https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/supercopa-campeones-ligapro-copa-ecuador.html |publisher=El Comercio |access-date=26 August 2021 |language=es |date=10 July 2019}}</ref>

==Background==
In 1970, the Ecuadorian Football Association (nowadays known as the [[Ecuadorian Football Federation]] or FEF), organized a tournament named ''Copa Ecuador'' to choose a representative for the [[1970 Copa Ganadores de Copa]]. This first edition was expected to be contested by the clubs placing from fourth to eighth in the previous [[1969 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|league championship]], however only three clubs participated: [[Barcelona S.C.|Barcelona]], [[C.D. El Nacional|El Nacional]], and [[C.D. Everest|Everest]], who had placed third, fourth and eighth in the previous season. After drawing with Barcelona and defeating Everest, and with both teams declining to play their final match, El Nacional won the competition and took part in the Copa Ganadores de Copa.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/el-nacional-campeon-copa-ecuador1970.html |title=El Nacional ganó la Copa Ecuador 1970 con solo dos partidos |trans-title=El Nacional won the 1970 Copa Ecuador with just two games |publisher=[[El Comercio (Ecuador)|El Comercio]] |language=es |date=27 November 2024 |access-date=27 November 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/ecua70.html |title=Ecuador 1970 |publisher=[[RSSSF]] |access-date=27 November 2024}}</ref>

The reinstatement of the Copa Ecuador was approved by the FEF on 18 May 2018, considering that the governing body would stop organizing the [[Ecuadorian Serie A|first]] and [[Ecuadorian Serie B|second]] tier championships starting from 2019 and that it was needed to both expand the scope of Ecuadorian football to more places within the country and generate new economic resources for the FEF and the lower tiers of domestic football, represented by the provincial associations.<ref name=Report/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/2018/07/04/nota/6843008/paso-competencias-fef-liga-profesional-futbol-empieza-derechos|title=El paso de competencias de la FEF a la Liga Profesional de Fútbol empieza con los derechos comerciales|publisher=El Universo|date=4 July 2018|access-date=26 December 2018}}</ref>

==Format==
For its first edition in 2019, the competition involved 48 teams and was divided into seven rounds. The first round was played by 22 teams from the provincial associations and 2 amateur teams, which were drawn into 12 two-legged ties. The 12 winners qualified for the second round, where they were drawn into six two-legged ties, with the winners advancing to the round of 32.

In the round of 32, the 6 winners from the previous round were joined by the 16 Serie A and 10 Serie B teams, who played in 16 two-legged ties with the winners advancing to the round of 16, from where the competition advanced to the quarter-finals, semi-finals, and final.<ref name=Report/>

For 2021, the FEF prepared a change of format with the competition having a preliminary stage involving the 10 Serie B teams and the 22 provincial champions, which would be drawn into 16 double-legged ties with the winners joining the 16 Serie A teams at the round of 32.<ref>{{cite web |title=(VIDEO) Así será el formato de la nueva Copa Ecuador 2021 |url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2021/05/03/video-asi-sera-el-formato-de-la-nueva-copa-ecuador-2021/ |publisher=Studio Fútbol |access-date=26 August 2021 |language=es |date=3 May 2021}}</ref> However, this format had to be implemented starting from [[2022 Copa Ecuador|2022]] as the 2021 edition was cancelled due to the effects of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador|COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref>{{cite web |title=OFICIAL: NO se realizará la Copa Ecuador en el 2021 |url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2021/08/24/oficial-no-se-realizara-la-copa-ecuador-en-el-2021/ |publisher=Studio Fútbol |access-date=26 August 2021 |language=es |date=24 August 2021}}</ref>
